notes.content:
January 29 is the last day when you can buy the game and DLC at the old price, on the 30 january the prices will be updated in accordance with Valve Corporation recommendations. 

Thanks for playing.

Kind regards,
Nastya Sinclair

notes.title: Game released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001762/8a0dd234b2ea61acaa179352a59dd4d633df3eee.png[/img]
Hello. today game "Secret Garden" released, to do this, I had to spend 1 year, some of the shortcomings and/or bugs from the "Moloko" game were taken into account and corrected, later, the "Moloko" game will also be updated, i hope that you are all well.

I wish you all a peaceful sky to you all.

Kind regards,
Nastya Sinclair
